summary_claims.claim: Art. 3 bans AI for administrative decisions without human intervention; Art. 4 bans AI pronouncing court judgments
Art. 11 fines up to RON 100,000,000 and two to five years' imprisonment

scope.note: Private members' bill rejected by the Senate and by the Chamber's committees, with little chance of passing; included because it is the only AI-specific bill before the Romanian Parliament.
